item.title: GMSmartAgent — via awesome-gamemaker
item.description: Decision-weighting AI for GameMaker. Utility scoring with response curves, per-target options, commitment, a frame-budget scheduler with priority tiers, and agents that learn from player choices: habit and preference models, re-ranking and prediction. Pure GML.
